At the same time, it can be suggested that the project team mint aToken immediately after the new market is created to prevent the market from being empty and manipulated. ### Reentrancy vulnerability caused by ERC677 / ERC777 tokens Similar to the second hack of Compound fork project Hundred Finance, in the Agave attack, the attacker called the liquidateCall function to liquidate himself without any debt. The token to be liquidated is the ERC-677 standard token used on the Gnosis Chain. When transferring this type of token, the function of the receiving address will be called externally, so the liquidation contract calls the attack contract. In the process, the attack contract deposited 2728 WETH obtained through flash loans, minted 2728 aWETH, and used this as collateral to borrow all available assets in the Agave project. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Decoding Hopelend’s $835k Exploit (https://www.quillaudits.com/blog/hack-analysis/hopelend-835k-exploit) citeturn36search2 [wordlim: 200] Published: 2.4 years ago; Crawled: 2 weeks ago; Attack Transaction: 0x1a7ee0a7efc70ed7429edef069a1dd001fbff378748d91f17ab1876dc6d10392 Hack Analysis # Decoding Hopelend’s $835k Exploit Uncover the details of the HopeLend Protocol's $835k exploit on Ethereum, executed via a Precision Loss vulnerability. Image: Author QuillAudits Team •June 4, 2024 ## Summary On the 18th of October 2023, HopeLend Protocol on the Ethereum chain was attacked. The attack was made possible by a Precision Loss vulnerability. Around $835k was stolen from the exploit. ### About Project HopeLend is a decentralized, non-custodial lending protocol. This allowed th... | The core vulnerability lies in the `withdraw` function of the `Pool` contract, specifically how it calculates the amount of underlying asset to transfer based on the user's `scaledBalanceOf` and the `totalSupply`. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- KyberSwap 被黑简单分析 | CTF导航 (https://www.ctfiot.com/147331.html) citeturn36search4 [wordlim: 200] Published: 3.8 years ago; Crawled: last week; * 分析样本：https://etherscan.io/tx/0x485e08dc2b6a4b3aeadcb89c3d18a37666dc7d9424961a2091d6b3696792f0f3 # KyberSwap 被黑简单分析 3年前 (2023)更新 admin 125 0 0 # 前言 KyberSwap 被黑的事情挺大的，被搞了45m，一开始是以为是4月份的那个问题，因为操纵痕迹上很像。但是仔细分析后发现不是。所以这里简单记录下方便回溯 # 简单技术分析 ## TDLR； * 核心问题：tick 操控导致的流动重复添加。原因为池本身的 reinvest计算导致tick的计算方式出了问题 * 分析样本：https://etherscan.io/tx/0x485e08dc2b6a4b3aeadcb89c3d18a37666dc7d9424961a2091d6b3696792f0f3 * 4月份问题 ref：https://100proof.org/kyberswap-post-mortem.html ## 攻击流程&原理分析 1. 攻击者首先耗光了池的流动性，把流动性（价格）打到一边。 2. KyberSwap Pool 区别于正常的 UniswapV3 Pool，创新性地把兑换产生的手续费计入流动性中，使手续费本身在兑换中也可以产生利息 3. 基于第二点的问题， 攻击者基于第一点的情况进行小额反向兑换，但兑换不触发 cross tick，根据代码逻辑，流程如下图：  Image: KyberSwap 被黑简单分析 4. 由于错误的计算了 currentTick，导致兑换结束后池的更新出现问题  Image: KyberSwap 被黑简单分析 5. 通过结合具体的 trace 可以验证我们的想法 Image: KyberSwap 被黑简单分析 ## 核心问题函数分析 核心的问题在于 `computeSwapStep` 函数中，直接看图  Image: KyberSwap 被黑简单分析 再看 Image: KyberSwap 被黑简单分析 最后这个得出来的价格再通过 `getTickAtSqrtRatio` 函数一算，tick就完全错了 ## 完.-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- KyberSwap Attack Analysis: Unveiling the Most Sophisticated Cyber Heist in History - AntChain Open Labs | Blogs (https://antchainopenlabs.github.io/2023/11/28/KyberSwap-Attack-Analysis-Unveiling-the-Most-Sophisticated-Cyber-Heist-in-History/) citeturn36search5 [wordlim: 200] Published: 2.9 years ago; Crawled: 2.7 years ago; > https://etherscan.io/tx/0x485e08dc2b6a4b3aeadcb89c3d18a37666dc7d9424961a2091d6b3696792f0f3 ## Addresses involved in the attack This attack involved multiple blockchains including Ethereum, Binance Smart Chain (previously referred to as Base), and Polygon, etc. Here, we will focus on analyzing an example of an attack transaction that occurred on the Ethereum blockchain. Attack transaction: > https://etherscan.io/tx/0x485e08dc2b6a4b3aeadcb89c3d18a37666dc7d9424961a2091d6b3696792f0f3 Attacker address: > 0x50275E0B7261559cE1644014d4b78D4AA63BE836 Attack contract: > 0xaF2Acf3D4ab78e4c702256D214a3189A874CDC13 KyberSwap contract (Vulnerable contract): > 0xfd7b111aa83b9b6f547e617c7601efd997f64703 ## Detailed analysis – a closer look ### Attack preparation The purpose of the preparation phase for an attack is to provide liquidity in an illiquid Tick range, creating conditions for the attack. The specific steps are as follows: 1. The attacker borrowed 2000 WETH through a flash loan from Aave V3. 2. The attacker called the `swap` function of the vulnerable contract and specified `limitSqrtP` as 20282409603651670423947251286016 (the price at Tick 110909). -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Olympix (https://www.olympix.security/biweekly-exploits/kyber-coinspot-thestandard-boundaries-broken-keys-leaked-logic-missed) citeturn36search6 [wordlim: 200] Published: 2.9 years ago; Crawled: last month; Transaction Hash: 0x485e08dc2b6a4b3aeadcb89c3d18a37666dc7d9424961a2091d6b3696792f0f3 The attacker initiated the exploit by borrowing 2,000 WETH in flash loans from AAVE and subsequently adding liquidity to frxETH and WETH pools. This additional liquidity provided the attacker with the means to adjust the pricing boundaries, allowing for manipulation of the exchange rate. Kyber Network confirmed the exploit and promptly paused the Elastic pools in response. Image Press enter or click to view image in full size Exploit Contract: 0xfd7b111aa83b9b6f547e617c7601efd997f64703 Transaction Hash: 0x485e08dc2b6a4b3aeadcb89c3d18a37666dc7d9424961a2091d6b3696792f0f3 ### CoinSpot | Amount Lost: $2.5M On November 8th, the CoinSpot exploit on the Ethereum Mainnet resulted in a $2.5M loss due to the compromise of private keys. The attacker drained 1,262 ETH and 21 ETH from two how wallets. The attacker then swapped the stolen funds to BTC and WBTC through THORChain and transferred them to Wan Bridge. The CoinSpot has not officially acknowledged the exploit.
